reconcile.note: Keil and Delitzsch read the seventh-day solemn assembly in Deuteronomy as a special emphasis within the feast, not a rival count shrinking it from seven days to six.

sides.snippet: seven days shall you eat unleavened bread therewith, even the bread of affliction
sides.verseText: You shall eat no leavened bread with it; seven days shall you eat unleavened bread therewith, even the bread of affliction; for you came forth out of the land of Egypt in haste: that you may remember the day when you came forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.

sides.snippet: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread; and on the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to Yahweh your God
sides.verseText: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread; and on the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to Yahweh your God; you shall do no work [therein].
